issues.where: crops A and C, sunlit globe above the foreground rings
issues.what: Broad cream-colored areas lose most of their cloud structure and look airbrushed beside the sharply resolved rings.
issues.fix: Pull back the highlight rolloff and preserve fine cloud texture through the brightest bands.

issues.where: crops S and T, foreground rings
issues.what: The near rings resolve into smooth, lengthwise smears. The bright bands vary across the rings but have very little visible texture along them, making the foreground read as a stretched stripe map.
issues.fix: Preserve the radial bands, but add subtle variation along the arcs and retain that detail with higher-resolution sampling.

issues.where: crops D and F, lower-left planetary limb just behind the ring
issues.what: A narrow copper strip has a conspicuously sharp inner edge against the bright cloud deck, making it look like a separate layer.
issues.fix: Blend the color and brightness transition into the adjacent clouds while retaining a crisp planetary silhouette.

issues.where: crops J and K, small orange moon above the planet
issues.what: The lit side is mostly a smooth orange gradient with little legible surface detail, giving the moon a plastic look.
issues.fix: Add restrained surface variation on the lit side without sharpening the silhouette.

issues.where: crops V and W, dense star field beside the dark outer ring
issues.what: Several of the brightest stars swell into soft round dots rather than retaining a compact bright core.
issues.fix: Tighten the brightest star cores and reduce their bloom while keeping the faint background points.
